Who did outside groups spend for and against?

Committees that received network money reported $372M against Republicans out of $490M in spending from all donors reported for or against members serving on Nov. 26, 2026.

Source · Federal Election Commission outside-spending filings

The filings identify the committee that spent the money. They cannot trace an expenditure to a donor. The total excludes 2 eligible entries with no direction reported ($104,964.75 and $800, $105,764.75 in all).

What share did network clients report on federal AI filings?

A comparison group of major tech and AI companies reported 6% of the dollars on 2025 filings naming any AI issue in this collection. The network share depends on which filings count.

Each 2025 federal filing reports one amount for all its issues. The percentages are shares of reported dollars.

Questions from the record

How common were gifts to those bills’ serving sponsors?

Among serving sponsors whose stand-alone bills appeared in Anthropic’s filings, 19 of 23 had employee or PAC gifts on file. Across all 533 serving members, including those sponsors, 201 did.

Stand-alone bills are individual proposals. The count leaves out broad packages such as spending bills.
